question: What share of enrolled women completed training and were employed six months later, by district and year?

view.title: Women's Training Completion and Employment by District
view.note: Each bar shows the percentage of enrolled women who completed training or were employed six months later. Select a year to compare districts. Rates are calculated as the number of women in the outcome divided by total women enrolled in that district and year.

interpretation_guard.caveat: This data is a synthetic fixture and does not represent real programme outcomes. Differences between districts may reflect sample size or random variation rather than programme quality.
